function: Excluded (system): AirComp aggregation of LoRA updates of a diffusion model over single-antenna scalar UGV-to-UAV links without RIS; resources and denoising factor are optimized, not learned (p. 5).
notes: Checks 1-5 pass: research article with simulation results (Figs. 4-10); it is federated learning over the air, since AirComp aggregates the LoRA updates (p. 5, Eq. 4: 'UGVs upload the fine-tuned local LoRA branch via AirComp') and a closed-form denoising factor is designed (p. 10, Theorem 3), so area 7 by function. Exclusion is system: the channel is one complex scalar per UGV-to-UAV link (p. 5: 'Let h_{i,t} in C represent the complex channel coefficient from UGV i to the UAV PS', frequency non-selective block fading), the paper never mentions antennas or arrays, Table I (p. 12) lists no antenna parameter, and RIS appears only as a reference (p. 17, [45]). The resource allocation is a block coordinate descent algorithm with convex subproblems (p. 11, Algorithm 4), not learned. One doubt for the reviewer: if the work is read as outside the seven areas, because only the denoising factor concerns the aggregation and the rest is downlink bandwidth, power and GPU allocation (p. 7), the code would be function instead of system. The decision is exclude either way.
